name: Dwindling Addler
body:
Dwindling Addler CR 7

A shimmering zigzag pattern decorates the back of the minuscule serpent, its eyes deceptively void of all but the most bestial of intellects.

XP 3,200
N Tiny magical beast
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+6 Dex, +3 natural, +2 size)
hp 85 (9d10+36)
Fort +9, Ref +9, Will +4
Immune acid

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., burrow 20 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +15 (1d4+4 plus grab and poison)
Special Attacks constrict 1d4+4

TACTICS

Before Combat The dwindling adder uses Stealth in an attempt to ambush prey. It will often take on much larger foes, counting on its venom to even the odds.

During Combat The creature attempts to poison as many opponents as possible and strategically retreats if necessary to let its poison take effect.

Morale If truly threatened, the dwindling adder will activate its compression ability and flee from battle, attempting to use Stealth to escape as soon as it is able.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 22, Con 16, Int 5, Wis 12, Cha 3
Base Atk +9; CMB +12; CMD 23 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Toughness, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +12, Climb +14, Perception +13, Stealth +15, Swim +11; Racial Modifiers +8 Acrobatics, +4 Stealth
SQ defensive compression

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 17; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect Target becomes a Microsized creature and shrinks 1 size category (its equipment is unaffected). Multiple failed saves stack the size reduction, to a minimum size of Fine.

Once every 24 hours, a creature whose size has been reduced by this poison can attempt a Fortitude save at the same DC. If they succeed, their size category slowly increases by 1 over the next 3d8 hours. If the target’s size returns to normal, they are no longer a Microsized creature.

Defensive Compression (Su)

A dwindling adder can change its size category to Fine or return to its true size as a standard action, otherwise functioning as reduce person. As a Fine creature, the dwindling adder gains the compression special ability.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or warm forests
Organization solitary, pair, or nest (3-5)
Treasure none

Uncommonly found near sites associated with transmutative magic, a dwindling adder is a strange, snakelike creature with the ability to adjust its size seemingly at will. True to its name, a dwindling adder transforms from a creature roughly the size of an average garden snake to a creature barely larger than a mouse, allowing it to slip away undetected from larger predators and creatures it is incapable of poisoning. For most other creatures, however, a dwindling addler’s true potency lies within its venom, which allows the creature to dwindle an adversary down to bite size, allowing the adder to easy capture and crush its prey before swallowing them whole. Unique enzymes within the addler’s gullet allow the addler to slowly grow its devoured prey back to its true size roughly as quickly as it digests them. This adaptation allows a dwindling addler to hunt significantly larger creatures and subside on their remains for months, even years.

Although the exact creation of the dwindling addler remains a mystery, today these snakes are known for their humanlike intelligence, all-terrain capabilities, and their sadistic tendencies.

According to several testimonies, sated addlers are known to bite large creatures for their own amusement, dragging their hapless prey back to their lairs and slowly stalking the diminished creature about until the creature inevitably collapses from exhaustion and starvation, at which point the addler takes its time swallowing and suffocating its victim. Particularly intelligence specimens have been known to force-feed their playthings and nurse them back to health, even allow them the false hope of growing several inches in size before the adder strikes again, ensuring months of “play time”. Because of their intelligence, it is incredibly difficult to milk a diminishing adder for their potent venom, but those who seek to do so exist. In most cases, the milking ends in catastrophe, as a single drop in an open wound is enough to poison a handler. This usually leads to the adder overpowering its captor during the chaos, wherein the pair exchange roles. In the rare case that diminishing adder venom is successfully acquired, it makes a potent tool for subduing and containing enemies.

New Poison

The following poison is available purchase with GM approval; it is extremely difficult to harvest because of the inherent danger in containing these creatures and the difficulty in capturing them in the first place, so it simply isn’t available in most regions, even the largest of cities.

Dwindling Adder Venom

Price 5,000 gp per dose

Type: Injury; save Fort DC 17; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect Target becomes Microsized and shrinks 1 size category (its equipment is unaffected). Multiple failed saves stack the size reduction, to a minimum size of Fine. Once every 24 hours, a creature whose size has been reduced by this poison can attempt a Fortitude save at the same DC. If they succeed, their size category slowly increases by 1 over the next 3d8 hours. If the target’s size returns to normal, they are no longer a Microsized creature.
